devdoc.details: This contract will be handling the; creating, processing and claiming of withdraw requests. Withdraw requests have their own ERC721 token and the ID of that token links to a WithdrawRequest struct within a mapping, this struct contains all the necessary metadata to manage withdraw requests.

AddressAlreadyInWhitelist(address).details: Throws an error indicating that the address is already in the whitelist.

params._address: The address that already exists in the whitelist.

AddressMissingFromWhitelist(address).details: Throws an error indicating that the address is missing from the whitelist.

params._address: The address that is missing from the whitelist.

CannotBeZeroAddress().details: Thrown when _checkZeroAddress is called with the zero address

CannotProcessWithdrawalsForNonExistentTo.details: Thrown when processing withdrawals and the provided _lastRequestIdToProcess hasn't been minted

InvalidMethodCall().details: Thrown in some contracts when the contract call is received by the fallback method

LastTokenIdToProcessMustBeGreaterOrEqual.details: Thrown when processing withdrawals and the provided _lastRequestIdToProcess is less than the previous token ID processed

NoTokensToWithdraw().details: Thrown when calling the withdrawERC20 method and the contracts balance is 0

NotInWhitelist().details: Throws an error indicating that the address is not in the whitelist.

WhitelistAlreadyDisabled().details: Throws an error indicating that the whitelist is already disabled.

WhitelistAlreadyEnabled().details: Throws an error indicating that the whitelist is already enabled.

WithdrawRequestMaximumMustBeGreaterOrEqu.details: Thrown when trying to update the withdrawal request maximum to be less than the withdrawal request minimum.

WithdrawRequestMinimumMustBeLessOrEqualT.details: Thrown when trying to update the withdrawal request minimum to be less than the withdrawal request maximum.

WithdrawRequestTooLarge(uint256,uint256).details: Thrown when the withdrawal request is too large

WithdrawRequestTooSmall(uint256,uint256).details: Thrown when the withdrawal request amount is less than the minimum.

WithdrawalRequestDoesNotExist().details: Thrown when trying to claim withdrawals for a token that doesn't exist

WithdrawalRequestFinalizationOnlyAllowed.details: Thrown when anyone except the owner tries to finalize a withdrawal request

WithdrawalRequestNotProcessed().details: Thrown when trying to claim withdrawals and the requested token has not been processed.

WithdrawalsPaused().details: Thrown when calling a withdrawal method and the withdrawals are paused.

addToWhitelist(address).details: Adds the specified address to the whitelist, reverts if not the platform admin

batchAddToWhitelist(address[]).details: Adds the array of addresses to the whitelist, reverts if not the platform admin.

batchRemoveFromWhitelist(address[]).details: Removes the array of addresses from the whitelist, reverts if not the platform admin

params._addresses: The array of addresses to remove.

params.amount: The amount of SwETH to withdraw.

disableWhitelist().details: Disables the whitelist, allowing all addresses to interact with the contract. Reverts if the caller is not the platform admin

enableWhitelist().details: Enables the whitelist, allowing only whitelisted addresses to interact with the contract. Reverts if the caller is not the platform admin

finalizeWithdrawal(uint256).details: Finalizes a withdrawal request, sending the ETH to the owner of the request. This is callable by anyone.

params.tokenId: The token ID of the withdrawal request to claim.

getLastTokenIdCreated().details: Returns the last token ID that was created.

getLastTokenIdProcessed().details: Returns the last token ID that was processed.

getProcessedRateForTokenId(uint256).details: Checks if the provided token ID has been processed and returns the rate it was processed at. NOTE: This isn't the final rate that the user will receive, it's just the rate that the withdrawal request was processed at.

returns.isProcessed: A boolean indicating whether or not the token ID has been processed.
returns.processedRate: The processed rate for the given token ID.

processWithdrawals(uint256).details: Processes withdrawals for a given range of token IDs.

params._lastTokenIdToProcess: The last token Id to process.

removeFromWhitelist(address).details: Removes the specified address from the whitelist, reverts if not the platform admin

setWithdrawRequestMaximum(uint256).details: Allows the platform admin to update the withdrawal request maximum.

setWithdrawRequestMinimum(uint256).details: Allows the platform admin to update the withdrawal request minimum.

withdrawERC20(address).details: This method withdraws contract's _token balance to a platform admin

params._token: The ERC20 token to withdraw from the contract

exitingETH.details: Returns the amount of exiting ETH, which is has not yet been processed for withdrawals.This value is increased by new withdrawal requests and decreased when withdrawals are processed.The amount is given by (amount * rate when requested), where amount is the amount of withdrawn swETH.
exitingETH.return: The current amount of exiting ETH.

returns._0: The current amount of exiting ETH.

totalETHExited.details: Returns the total amount of exited ETH to date. Exited ETH is ETH that was processed in a withdrawal request.When ETH is processed in a withdrawal request, the amount of exited ETH is given by (amount * finalRate), where finalRate is the lesser of the rate when requested and the processed rate, and amount is the amount of withdrawn swETH.

withdrawRequestMaximum.details: Returns the withdrawal request maximum size.
